video_title: Luka Dončić Opens Up About LeBron Leaving Lakers, Becoming Team Leader & Britney Spears Fandom

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his competitive nature and desire to win
quotes.excerpt: I think I'm just a lot competitive, you know, I just want to win.
quotes.quote: I think I'm just a lot competitive, you know, I just want to win.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his decision to join Real Madrid
quotes.excerpt: I want to play basketball, this is the best European club.
quotes.quote: I want to play basketball, this is the best European club. It was probably one of my best decisions in life.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on LeBron James leaving the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Thank you for everything, you know, it obviously was an amazing being his teammate.
quotes.quote: Thank you for everything, you know, it obviously was an amazing being his teammate. I learned so many things.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on the pressure of being the Lakers leader
quotes.excerpt: Obviously they're going to say it's a lot more pressure, but it's not really pressure, it's an honor.
quotes.quote: Obviously they're going to say it's a lot more pressure, but it's not really pressure, it's an honor.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on the Lakers' roster depth for playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I think we're very deep, which is very important, especially going to the playoffs.
quotes.quote: I think we're very deep, which is very important, especially going to the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves on Luka Dončić's elite pick-and-roll play
quotes.excerpt: He's one of the greatest point guards in the pick-and-roll in the league, if not the best.
quotes.quote: He's one of the greatest point guards in the pick-and-roll in the league, if not the best.

quotes.speaker: Luka Dončić
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Dončić on his offseason conditioning and recovery
quotes.excerpt: Not playing for national team, you know, I'm more rested definitely.
